reuse.why: Adds the rule to the existing getMonthWideCategories that every month-wide action already uses, and parses the tag with the existing extractTagsFromText.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the tag rule is written once.

placement.why: The exclusion sits in the shared month-wide category selection in budget/actions.ts, beside the hidden and template exclusions.

scope.why: Only the selection function and its tests change.

maintainability.why: Single, well-commented definition; splitting it into a second query plus an in-memory filter is slightly less direct than folding it into the existing query, but stays easy to own.

one_place.where: getMonthWideCategories in server/budget/actions.ts, used by copyPreviousMonth, setZero and the average/last-month actions.
